formula_language.safe_divide: safe_divide(a,b) returns null when b is zero or null; it never returns infinity.
formula_language.business_date: All events are assigned to the organisation's configured business date and time zone.
formula_language.currency: Monetary metrics use transaction-currency amounts or an explicitly named reporting currency translated with the approved transaction-date FX snapshot.
formula_language.returns: Returns are recognized on the accepted return date unless a metric explicitly states order-date restatement.
formula_language.net_units: fulfilled units minus accepted return units, excluding cancelled quantities.

resolution: Metric fields inherit missing governance values from defaults before publication.

business_question.ru: Какова стоимость заказанного или отгруженного товара до скидок и возвратов?
business_question.en: What is the value of ordered or fulfilled merchandise before discounts and returns?

metrics.numerator: sum of line quantity multiplied by frozen gross unit price
filters: exclude test orders
quantity based on requested measure: ordered or fulfilled
metrics.time_semantics: order confirmation date for ordered view; fulfillment date for fulfilled view
tests: gross sales equals the sum of eligible line extensions
currency is never mixed without approved FX translation
cancelled quantity is excluded from fulfilled view

business_question.ru: Какова выручка после скидок, возвратов и кредит-нот, но без возмещаемых налогов?
business_question.en: What is revenue after discounts, returns and credit notes, excluding recoverable taxes?

metrics.formula: gross_sales_value - line_discount_value - order_discount_allocated_value - accepted_return_value - credit_note_value + non_refundable_surcharge_value
filters: exclude recoverable VAT/GST
include only accepted returns and issued credit notes
metrics.time_semantics: recognized on invoice/fulfillment date; returns on accepted return date
tests: net sales reconciles to invoiced revenue ledger by reporting currency
net sales cannot include cancelled unfulfilled quantity
return value uses frozen accepted-return valuation

business_question.ru: Сколько валовой прибыли остаётся после себестоимости реализованного товара?

metrics.time_semantics: same recognition date as net sales and related COGS

returned COGS is reversed consistently with return value
valuation basis is stored with the metric run

business_question.ru: Какая доля чистой выручки остаётся в валовой марже?
business_question.en: What share of net sales remains as gross margin?

filters: same currency and recognition basis in numerator and denominator
metrics.time_semantics: reporting-period recognized revenue
tests: aggregate percentage is recomputed from sums and never averaged across rows
returns reverse both revenue and COGS

business_question.ru: Какова средняя чистая стоимость подтверждённого заказа?

business_question.ru: Сколько единиц товара в среднем содержит подтверждённый заказ?

metrics.time_semantics: order confirmation date
tests: quantity is not multiplied by line versions

business_question.ru: Какая доля квалифицированных коммерческих сессий завершилась подтверждённым заказом?

metrics.denominator: qualified showroom, appointment or order-builder sessions

business_question.ru: Какая доля активных клиентов совершила повторный заказ в заданном окне?

business_question.ru: Какая доля отгруженного количества была принята к возврату?

business_question.ru: Какая доля клиентских поставок доставлена вовремя и в полном объёме?
business_question.en: What share of customer deliveries arrived on time and in full?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(delivery_line where delivered_on_time and delivered_in_full), COUNT(eligible_delivery_line))
metrics.numerator: eligible delivery lines both on time and in full
metrics.denominator: eligible delivery lines due in period
filters: promise version and grace period explicit
customer-requested reschedules handled by approved policy
metrics.time_semantics: due-window cohort measured after grace period
tests: on-time and in-full components are independently reproducible
partial shipments consolidate according to policy

business_question.ru: Какая доля поставок прибыла в обещанное окно?
business_question.en: What share of deliveries arrived within the promised window?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(delivery_line where delivered_at within promised_window_plus_grace), COUNT(eligible_delivery_line))
metrics.numerator: delivery lines arriving within promise and grace
filters: delivery event definition is configured: first attempt or proof of delivery
metrics.time_semantics: promised window cohort
tests: one delivery completion event per delivery line

business_question.ru: Какая доля строк доставлена в полном подтверждённом количестве?
business_question.en: What share of lines was delivered in the full confirmed quantity?

metrics.numerator: eligible lines delivered in full by cutoff
filters: due quantity uses approved cancellation policy
cutoff is promise end plus grace
metrics.time_semantics: promised-window cohort at cutoff

business_question.ru: Сколько календарных дней в среднем проходит от фактического отправления до доставки?
business_question.en: How many calendar days pass on average from actual departure to delivery?

filters: completed shipments only
shipment- or leg-level basis explicit
metrics.time_semantics: actual departure to proof-of-delivery timestamps

business_question.ru: Какова распределённая стоимость перевозки на принятую единицу?
business_question.en: What is allocated freight cost per accepted unit?

metrics.numerator: allocated freight, fuel, security and handling charges
filters: allocation driver version retained
exclude duties and taxes unless explicitly requested
metrics.time_semantics: receipt or freight invoice accounting date

business_question.ru: Какая доля полезного объёма транспортной единицы использована грузом?
business_question.en: What share of usable transport-unit volume is occupied by cargo?

metrics.denominator: usable container, truck or pallet cubic metres
filters: use usable rather than theoretical capacity when configured
metrics.time_semantics: transport unit close date
tests: values above 100 percent are retained and flagged

business_question.ru: Какая доля доставленных единиц повреждена в логистическом процессе?
business_question.en: What share of delivered units was damaged during logistics?

filters: deduplicate damage claims by unit and incident
metrics.time_semantics: delivery-date cohort

business_question.ru: Какая доля доступных аккаунтов имела квалифицированную активность или заказ в окне активности?
business_question.en: What share of eligible accounts had qualified activity or an order in the activity window?

filters: qualifying events and lookback window are configured
metrics.time_semantics: account eligibility overlap with reporting period and activity lookback
tests: accounts are deduplicated at configured parent/door grain

business_question.ru: Какая доля аккаунтов базового периода сохранила активность или покупку в следующем периоде?
business_question.en: What share of baseline-period accounts remained active or purchasing in the following period?

metrics.numerator: baseline accounts retained in follow-up window
filters: retention event and windows are fixed
new accounts in follow-up are not in denominator
metrics.time_semantics: fixed baseline and follow-up cohort windows
tests: merged accounts use a documented identity bridge

business_question.ru: Какая доля аккаунтов базового периода не сохранила активность в следующем периоде?
business_question.en: What share of baseline-period accounts did not remain active in the following period?

filters: uses same cohort and activity definition as retention
metrics.time_semantics: fixed baseline and follow-up cohort windows
tests: retention plus churn equals 100 percent within tolerance

business_question.ru: Какая доля квалифицированных лидов стала аккаунтом или возможностью по утверждённому правилу?
business_question.en: What share of qualified leads became an account or opportunity under the approved rule?

metrics.numerator: qualified leads with conversion event within attribution window
filters: conversion event and attribution window are configured
duplicates merged before qualification count
metrics.time_semantics: lead qualification date cohort

business_question.ru: Какая доля закрытых возможностей выиграна?
business_question.en: What share of closed opportunities was won?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT_DISTINCT(opportunity where terminal_stage = 'won'), COUNT_DISTINCT(opportunity where terminal_stage in ['won','lost']))
filters: exclude open, cancelled and duplicate opportunities
metrics.time_semantics: terminal close date
tests: one terminal outcome per opportunity version

business_question.ru: Сколько дней в среднем проходит от квалификации до закрытия возможности?
business_question.en: How many days pass on average from qualification to opportunity close?

filters: closed won and lost included unless filtered
paused time shown separately
metrics.time_semantics: qualification to terminal close timestamps
tests: open opportunities excluded and aging reported separately

business_question.ru: Какая доля завершённых buying appointments не привела к заказу в атрибуционном окне?
business_question.en: What share of completed buying appointments did not lead to an order within the attribution window?

metrics.numerator: completed appointments without attributed confirmed order
filters: attribution window and eligible appointment types are configured
metrics.time_semantics: appointment completion date cohort
tests: no-order reason required after maturity cutoff

business_question.ru: Какая доля обязательных полей заполнена для выбранных объектов и контекста?
business_question.en: What share of required fields is populated for the selected objects and context?

metrics.denominator: required field instances resolved by object type, stage and market
filters: requiredness rule version is frozen
metrics.time_semantics: quality check execution timestamp against object version
tests: not-applicable fields are excluded with reason

business_question.ru: Какая доля записей не является дубликатом по утверждённому ключу сопоставления?
business_question.en: What share of records is not duplicated under the approved matching key?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(record not in duplicate_cluster beyond canonical record), COUNT(eligible_record))
metrics.numerator: eligible records considered canonical or unique
filters: matching rule and threshold version fixed
metrics.time_semantics: quality-run timestamp
tests: each duplicate cluster has one canonical record
records do not belong to overlapping clusters

business_question.ru: Какая доля проверяемых значений соответствует формату, диапазону и доменным правилам?
business_question.en: What share of checked values conforms to format, range and domain rules?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(value_check where passed), COUNT(value_check with terminal result))
filters: warning and error treatment configurable but explicit
metrics.time_semantics: quality-run timestamp against object version
tests: one terminal result per field-rule pair

business_question.ru: Какая доля данных обновлена в пределах установленного SLA свежести?
business_question.en: What share of data was refreshed within its freshness SLA?

filters: SLA and expected update calendar version are fixed
metrics.time_semantics: quality-run timestamp compared with latest successful source event
tests: failed refresh does not reset freshness

business_question.ru: Какая доля межобъектных и межсистемных проверок не выявила противоречий?
business_question.en: What share of cross-object and cross-system checks found no contradictions?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(consistency_check where passed), COUNT(consistency_check with terminal result))
filters: rule version and comparison as-of time are fixed
metrics.time_semantics: common as-of timestamp or documented latency allowance
tests: one terminal result per rule-entity pair
source latency is not mislabeled as inconsistency

business_question.ru: Какая доля положительных предсказаний модели действительно положительна?
business_question.en: What share of positive model predictions is truly positive?

filters: ground truth and evaluation dataset version fixed
metrics.time_semantics: evaluation dataset observation period and evaluation run timestamp

business_question.ru: Какую долю истинно положительных случаев модель обнаружила?
business_question.en: What share of truly positive cases did the model identify?

filters: ground truth and evaluation dataset version fixed
metrics.time_semantics: evaluation dataset observation period and evaluation run timestamp

business_question.ru: Каков гармонический баланс precision и recall?
business_question.en: What is the harmonic balance of precision and recall?

filters: precision and recall use identical population and averaging mode
metrics.time_semantics: same evaluation run as component metrics
tests: result is between zero and one
zero precision plus recall returns null
do not average precomputed F1 without declared macro mode

business_question.ru: Для какой доли подходящих запросов модель смогла выдать допустимую рекомендацию?
business_question.en: For what share of eligible requests could the model produce an admissible recommendation?

metrics.numerator: eligible requests with at least one admissible recommendation
filters: policy-blocked and technically failed requests are classified separately
metrics.time_semantics: request timestamp
tests: empty candidate sets do not count as covered

business_question.ru: Какую долю применимых решений пользователя пришлось изменить после рекомендации модели?
business_question.en: What share of applicable model-assisted decisions was changed by a user?

metrics.formula: 100 * safe_divide(COUNT(model_assisted_decision with material_override), COUNT(model_assisted_decision with final_user_action))
metrics.denominator: model-assisted decisions with a final user action
filters: material-override rule version fixed
no-action cases reported separately
metrics.time_semantics: final user decision timestamp
tests: override reason required for critical use cases

business_question.ru: Насколько текущее распределение признака отличается от базового?
business_question.en: How much does the current feature distribution differ from the baseline?

metrics.formula: SUM_over_bins((current_share - baseline_share) * LN(safe_divide(current_share, baseline_share))) using configured epsilon for zero bins
metrics.numerator: bin share differences weighted by log share ratio
filters: baseline dataset and bin edges frozen
epsilon explicitly configured
metrics.time_semantics: monitoring window compared with fixed baseline period
tests: bin shares each sum to one within tolerance
result is non-negative within numerical tolerance
bin edges do not change across comparison
